verdict.rationale: Ghostty's documented Quick Terminal is a lightweight terminal that animates down below the menu bar for instant access, which is the quake-style dropdown this story describes. A community user independently calls it Ghostty's killer feature. The docs mention flexible custom keybindings but never say how the Quick Terminal is summoned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a system-wide global hotkey to summon or toggle the Quick Terminal, evidence of dropdown support beyond macOS (e.g. Linux), and details on configuring position or animation.
